holderQuote: The Lich hovered there, one of many, casting spells. Raining death down. Halrac cursed as he put another arrow to his bow. Yet—he was a [Marksman], yes, but he wasn’t Bird or Badarrow.
She placed four on the ground and then raised her enchanted bow.
effectQuote: Her bow began to sing. All eighty arrows began to loose into the air with the ones she manually fired.
